env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Ordinary Go imports erase const qualifiers; native placement is still protected.
# Checked loGo/s alias rejection is covered separately, not bypassed here.
cd prog
logos build -o prog.exe .
exec ./prog.exe
stdout '^read 2s 1.000042ms March drwxr-xr-x 2 2 3ns true 3 2 true 5$'
stdout '^ok slice-fault$'
stdout '^ok months-fault$'
stdout '^ok modes-fault$'
stdout '^ok nested-fault$'
stdout '^ok anon-fault$'
stdout '^ok lists-fault$'
stdout '^ok stamps-fault$'
stdout '^ok recs-fault$'
! stdout 'FAIL'

exec go tool nm prog.exe
stdout ' R example\.com/rodvalues/p\.Slice$'
stdout ' R example\.com/rodvalues/p\.Slice\.logos_backing0$'
stdout ' R example\.com/rodvalues/p\.Array$'
stdout ' R example\.com/rodvalues/p\.Months$'
stdout ' R example\.com/rodvalues/p\.Months\.logos_backing0$'

stdout ' R example\.com/rodvalues/p\.Modes\.logos_backing0$'

-- prog/go.mod --
module example.com/rodimported

go 1.27

require example.com/rodvalues v0.0.0

replace example.com/rodvalues => ../lib

-- lib/go.mod --
module example.com/rodvalues

go 1.27

-- lib/p/values.lgo --
package p

import (
	"os"
	"time"
)

type Rec struct {
	At time.Time
	N  int
}

type Lists struct {
	L []time.Duration
	N int
}

const Slice = []time.Duration{time.Second, 2 * time.Second}
const Array = [8]time.Duration{time.Millisecond, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9}
const Months = []time.Month{time.March, 12}
const Modes = []os.FileMode{0o644, os.ModeDir | 0o755}
const Nested = [][]time.Duration{{1, 2}, {3}}
const Anon = []struct{ D time.Duration }{{time.Second}, {2}}
const ListsValue = Lists{L: []time.Duration{time.Minute, 5}, N: 3}
const Stamps = []time.Time{{}, {}}
const Recs = []Rec{{N: 4}, {N: 5}}

-- prog/main.go --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unsafe"

	. "example.com/rodvalues/p"
)

var failed bool

func check(name string, cond bool, got, want any) {
	if !cond {
		failed = true
		fmt.Println("FAIL", name+":", "got", got, "want", want)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

func poke(name string) {
	switch name {
	case "slice":
		*unsafe.SliceData(Slice) = 0
	case "months":
		*unsafe.SliceData(Months) = 0
	case "modes":
		*unsafe.SliceData(Modes) = 0
	case "nested":
		*unsafe.SliceData(Nested[0]) = 0
	case "anon":
		*(*time.Duration)(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(Anon))) = 0
	case "stamps":
		*unsafe.SliceData(Stamps) = time.Time{}
	case "recs":
		*unsafe.SliceData(Recs) = Rec{}
	case "lists":
		*unsafe.SliceData(ListsValue.L) = 0
	}
	fmt.Println("STORE-SUCCEEDED")
}

func faults(self, name string) {
	cmd := exec.Command(self, name)
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout = &buf
	cmd.Stderr = &buf
	runErr := cmd.Run()
	code := -1
	if ee, ok := runErr.(*exec.ExitError); ok {
		code = ee.ExitCode()
	}
	out := buf.String()
	check(name+"-fault", runErr != nil && code == 2 && strings.Contains(out, "fault") && !strings.Contains(out, "STORE-SUCCEEDED"), out, "fault without STORE-SUCCEEDED")
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		poke(os.Args[1])
		return
	}
	at := len(os.Args) - 1
	var sum time.Duration
	for _, d := range Array {
		sum += d
	}
	fmt.Println("read", Slice[1], sum, Months[at], Modes[1], len(Nested), len(Nested[0]), Nested[1][0], Anon[at].D == time.Second, ListsValue.N, len(Stamps), Stamps[1].IsZero(), Recs[1].N)
	self, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL executable:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"slice", "months", "modes", "nested", "anon", "lists", "stamps", "recs"} {
		faults(self, name)
	}
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
